newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLAND TO LOSE LONG-TIME SPONSORS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLAND TO LOSE LONG-TIME SPONSORS.

text.p: England's cricket team are to lose long-time sponsors Carlsberg Tetley.

Tetley, who are understood to have pumped more than 10 million pounds ($16 million) into the English game since becoming involved in 1991, have cut short an agreement originally planned to extend until September 1999.
The company announced on Friday that it is not taking up the final two-year option.
But Tetley spokesman John Haywood stressed that England's poor performances in recent years had not influenced the decision to end the sponsorship in September next year.
"Our decision was based entirely on the marketing requirements of Tetley," he said.
